cases.translation: The play was supposed to start in half an hour.
cases.explain: Спектакль is the subject of должен был начаться (was supposed to start), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: Yurka jumped down from the stage.
cases.explain: The preposition с(о) (off/from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Yurka got ready for the disco all day.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: Ksyusha finally gave him a kiss.
cases.explain: Поцелуй is the direct object of подарила (gave), a transitive verb, so it is accusative.

cases.translation: The tree was decorated with a garland.
cases.explain: The instrumental case гирляндой expresses the means by which the tree was decorated.

cases.translation: Everyone was having fun at the dance floor.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Внутри было почти пусто.
reading.question: What was the movie hall like when Yurka rushed in with the finished script?
reading.explain: The text says it was almost empty inside.

reading.ru: Маша играла на пианино, а Володя склонился над ней и слушал.
reading.question: What scene does Yurka walk in on?
options: Masha playing piano while Volodya listens, leaning over her
An empty stage with no one around
reading.correct: Masha playing piano while Volodya listens, leaning over her
reading.explain: Masha was playing the piano while Volodya leaned over her, listening.

reading.ru: «Неплохо, но нужно потренироваться ещё».
reading.question: What is Volodya's verdict on Masha's playing?
options: Not bad, but she needs more practice
She should give up the role
reading.correct: Not bad, but she needs more practice
reading.explain: Volodya says it's not bad but she needs more practice.

reading.ru: «Гестаповец Краузе. Роль второстепенная, но важная.
reading.question: What role does Volodya give Yurka?
reading.explain: Volodya assigns Yurka the role of the Gestapo officer Krause.

reading.ru: Но всё-таки его бабушка потеряла мужа.
reading.question: What did Yurka's grandmother lose, connected to why he dislikes the Nazi role?
reading.explain: The text explains his grandmother lost her husband, tied to his discomfort playing a German soldier.

reading.ru: «Перестань!» – выкрикнул он. «Хватит играть, говорю!»
reading.question: What does Yurka shout at Masha during rehearsal?
reading.explain: Yurka shouts for Masha to stop playing.

reading.ru: «Маша, это отвратительно!»
reading.question: How does Yurka describe Masha's playing of the lullaby?
reading.explain: Yurka calls her playing 'отвратительно' (disgusting).

reading.ru: «Маша, ты полная бездарность!»
reading.question: What harsh insult does Yurka throw at Masha?
options: That she's a complete talentless person
reading.correct: That she's a complete talentless person
reading.explain: Yurka calls her a complete бездарность (talentless person).

reading.ru: А потом тихо заплакала.
reading.question: How does Masha react after Yurka's outburst?
options: She storms out of the room
reading.explain: Masha quietly begins to cry after his harsh words.

reading.ru: «Пойдём выйдем!» Прошипел Володя, утаскивая его со сцены.
reading.question: What does Volodya do immediately after Yurka's outburst?
options: Drags him off the stage to talk outside
reading.correct: Drags him off the stage to talk outside
reading.explain: Volodya hisses for them to step out and pulls Yurka off the stage.

reading.ru: Ты хотя бы понимаешь, что поступил жестоко?
reading.question: What does Volodya ask Yurka outside?
options: Whether he understands he acted cruelly
Whether he wants to quit the play
reading.correct: Whether he understands he acted cruelly
reading.explain: Volodya asks if Yurka understands that he acted cruelly.

reading.ru: У меня сердце кровью обливается, когда я слышу машины потуги.
reading.question: How does Yurka describe his reaction to hearing Masha's attempts at playing?
options: His heart bleeds when he hears her struggling attempts
He feels proud of her effort
reading.correct: His heart bleeds when he hears her struggling attempts
reading.explain: Yurka says his heart bleeds hearing Masha's struggling attempts (потуги).

reading.ru: «Нравилась одна», – честно признался он.
reading.question: What does Yurka honestly admit about liking girls?
reading.explain: Yurka honestly admits he liked one girl.

reading.ru: Просто нравится или... Или больше, чем просто.
reading.question: What question does Volodya press Yurka with about his feelings?
options: Whether it's just liking someone, or more than that
Whether he wants to leave camp
Whether he wants to quit the play
reading.correct: Whether it's just liking someone, or more than that
reading.explain: Volodya asks whether it's simply liking someone, or something more.

reading.ru: «Хорошо?» – обалдел Юрка.
reading.question: How does Yurka react when Volodya calls his own confession of love 'good'?
reading.explain: Yurka is stunned (обалдел) at Volodya's odd reaction.

reading.ru: «Она из другого... эм... круга.
reading.question: How does Yurka describe the girl he supposedly likes, to explain why he thinks there's no chance?
options: She's from a different social circle
reading.correct: She's from a different social circle
reading.explain: Yurka says she's from a different 'circle', implying incompatible social standing.

reading.ru: «Тогда у меня хорошие новости. Никакая это не любовь, потому что в любви нет эгоизма».
reading.question: What conclusion does Yurka reach about his own feelings after Volodya's explanation of love?
options: That it's not love at all, since love has no selfishness
That he is definitely in love
That Volodya is wrong about love
reading.correct: That it's not love at all, since love has no selfishness
reading.explain: Yurka concludes it must not be love, because love has no room for egoism.

reading.ru: «Было», — ответил Володя, не глядя на Юрку.
reading.question: How does Volodya answer when asked if he's had unrequited love before?
options: He confirms it happened, without looking at Yurka
reading.correct: He confirms it happened, without looking at Yurka
reading.explain: Volodya answers 'Было' (it happened), avoiding eye contact.

reading.ru: «Не скажу, это слишком личное».
reading.question: Why won't Volodya reveal the name of the girl he loves?
options: He says he forgot her name
He says it's a state secret
reading.explain: Volodya refuses, saying it's too personal.

reading.ru: «Я пойду на дискотеку. Прямо сегодня».
reading.question: What does Volodya decide to do, encouraged by the conversation?
options: Go to the disco that very evening
Ask Lena for the night off tomorrow
reading.correct: Go to the disco that very evening
reading.explain: Volodya decides he will go to the disco today.

reading.ru: Яблони вокруг танцплощадки были увешаны электрическими гирляндами.
reading.question: How were the apple trees around the dance floor decorated?
reading.explain: The apple trees around the dance floor were hung with electric garlands.

reading.ru: «Зачем ты выбросила мой лак?» – кричала взбешённая Ксюша.
reading.question: What is Ksyusha furious about in the girls' room?
reading.explain: Ksyusha screams furiously about her lacquer (лак) being thrown out.

reading.ru: Угадай, кто сегодня придет на дискотеку?
reading.question: What does Yurka tease Ksyusha with as 'good news'?
options: Guessing who's coming to the disco tonight
reading.correct: Guessing who's coming to the disco tonight
reading.explain: Yurka teases her to guess who's coming to the disco today.

reading.ru: «Он очень модный сейчас в Москве, Ленинграде и Прибалтике. Брейк-дэнс называется.
reading.question: What dance does Alyosha Matveev claim is fashionable in Moscow, Leningrad, and the Baltics?
reading.explain: Alyosha calls his dance 'break-dance', claiming it's fashionable in those cities.

reading.ru: Ольга Леонидовна вышла на сцену ровно на одну минуту и без предисловий громогласно объявила в микрофон, что по результатам подсчета голосов победила дружба.
reading.question: What did Olga Leonidovna announce as the result of Zarnitsa?
options: That the game would be replayed
reading.explain: Olga Leonidovna announces that 'friendship' won, i.e., the game ended in a tie.
